name: q1_source_model_selection_v1
status: frozen before computing any W/S per-class operating-point result
question: Under the operating point 'every fault class recall >= T0 baseline', which existing source-domain candidate gives the lowest normal false alarms, and which one should be kept as the stable source model?
why_new: E-group post-hoc applied this operating point only to T1/GBT/E0/E1. W1/W2/S1/S2/S3 and their GBT ensembles were never compared under one operating point; the pooled-R97 C3 rule blocked T1/V/E for the same late-hover GPS reason, so the operating point itself is the open decision.
training: none; zero-training analysis of existing train-CV held-out predictions
data_boundary: train CV held-out only (162069 windows, folds sha256('h1cv|'+association_group)%3). No val, no internal test, no Real.
disclosure: Per-class operating-point FP for T1/GBT/E0/E1 was already seen (E-group supplement, 2026-11-08). The train-CV population has been analysed repeatedly. The outcome is a candidate selection, not an independent confirmation.

reference.arm: T0 (inner-CE early stopping; t_selection_mstca_v1 selections.json T0 epoch)
reference.operating_point: T0's own FP@R97 threshold per seed; per-class recall r0[c] taken at that threshold
reference.gate: T0 FP@R97 seeds 42/43/44 = 3595/3588/4610; S0 best FP for 42/43/44 must equal the same numbers

single_model.W1: w_phase_balance_mstca_v1 W1, frozen T0-rule epoch from selections.json, seeds 42-46
single_model.S1: s_ablation_mstca_v1 S1 (no SE), best weights, seeds 42-44
single_model.S2: s_ablation_mstca_v1 S2 (three-branch k7), best weights, seeds 42-44
single_model.S3: s_ablation_mstca_v1 S3 (matched CNN), best weights, seeds 42-44
single_model.GBT: feature_groupcv_v1 gbt_heldout.npz, single fit random_state 0, shared across seeds

arms.ensemble: plain mean of the arm's fault probability and GBT: E0=T0+GBT, E1=T1+GBT, W1+GBT, W2+GBT, S1+GBT, S2+GBT, S3+GBT
arms.sensitivity_only: S1/S2/S3 last weights (single and +GBT); never used for selection

operating_point.main: per arm and seed, the highest threshold t such that for each of the 6 fault classes the arm's class TP count >= T0's class TP count at T0's R97 threshold (same seed); FP_pc = normal windows with score >= t
operating_point.strict_variant: same plus a 7th stratum: late-hover GPS fault windows (hover, window_end_row*0.02 > 30 s)
operating_point.pairing: each arm is paired with T0 of the same seed; S arms use seeds 42-44 only

metrics.primary: FP_pc ratio arm/T0 per seed, geometric mean over the arm's seeds
metrics.ci: association_group cluster bootstrap, 2000 replicates, rng 20261106; T0 thresholds and class TP targets recomputed inside each replicate
secondary: seed SD and coefficient of variation of FP_pc
late-hover GPS recall and late-hover independent-normal FP at the main operating point

out-of-fold threshold transfer: thresholds (T0 R97 and the arm's per-class threshold) chosen on the other two folds, applied to the held-out fold; report FP ratio and per-class recall difference vs T0

selection_rule.eligible: geometric-mean ratio < 1, every seed ratio < 1, bootstrap CI upper < 1 (main operating point)
selection_rule.best: eligible arm with the lowest ratio, compared on its own seeds
selection_rule.parsimony: if a single-model arm is eligible and the paired bootstrap ratio best/single (common seeds) has CI upper >= 1, keep the single model instead of the ensemble
selection_rule.flags: report, do not override: strict-variant ratio >= 1; out-of-fold per-class recall deficit > 1 pp for any class; S arms judged on 3 seeds only

expected_information_gain: A single ranking of all existing candidates under one operating point; whether any MSTCA variant (W, S) improves on T0/T1 inside the GBT ensemble; whether the per-class operating point transfers out of fold; a named candidate for the stable source model.
not_allowed: changing the operating point or rule after seeing W/S results
outputs: artifacts/q1_source_model_selection_v1/evaluation.json; report docs/research/2026-11-08/Q1源域候选统一评价_v1.md
